entries.title: New project
entries.text: Starts a new project with no builds, notes, to-dos or plans. Give it a name; it becomes the active project unless you turn that off.

entries.title: Switch to it right away
entries.text: On: the new project becomes the active one for every device and session as soon as it is created.

entries.title: Switch or manage projects
entries.text: Opens the project list: switch, start a new one, rename, archive or delete (archive and delete ask you to type the project id; the data stays on disk).

entries.title: Project on the banner
entries.text: Shows the active project as a chip on the banner. Tap the chip to switch.

entries.title: Projects
entries.text: Settings for the project switcher: the banner chip, reloading after a switch, and the CLI and API to do the same without the console.

entries.title: New project
entries.text: Opens the form for a new, empty project.
